candidate_sentences.text: Consolidated revenue declined 3.4% to €7.328 million from €7.592 million in 2024, with fibreboard revenue falling 3.2% to €7.325 million.
Sales within the European Union, representing 92% of revenue, were broadly stable, while sales to Africa, Asia and the Middle East declined.
Real-estate management revenue fell to €3 thousand from €25 thousand following the termination of rental agreements in August 2024 because communal costs could not be covered by rental income.

verified_key_information_units.information: Consolidated EBITDA was -€0.42 million in 2025 (vs -€0.03 million in 2024) with a margin of -6% (vs 0%), and net loss widened to €1.15 million from €0.79 million; the decline was driven by underutilized production capacity increasing costs and a planned December 2025 factory shutdown for new gas boiler house transition (compared to an unplanned weather-related shutdown in 2024).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report Overview of Operating Results (page 4), EBITDA by Business Segments table (page 4), Management Report Fibreboard Production section (page 4-5)

candidate_sentences.text: Profitability deteriorated significantly.
EBITDA declined to a loss of €420 thousand from a loss of €25 thousand, reducing the EBITDA margin to negative 6% from 0%.

The fibreboard segment moved from positive EBITDA of €26 thousand to negative €296 thousand, primarily because of underutilized production capacity, which increased the cost of internally produced goods.
EBITDA was also negatively affected by approximately €0.2 million of personnel, maintenance and repair costs during the December factory shutdown.
The 2025 shutdown was planned to facilitate the transition to a new gas boiler house, whereas the 2024 shutdown was unplanned and resulted from weather-related structural damage.
Nevertheless, net loss widened to €1.154 million from €786 thousand, although loss per share improved to €0.14 from €0.17 because the number of shares increased substantially.

verified_key_information_units.information: Total assets increased to €9.3 million (from €8.3 million in 2024), with current assets at €1.829 million (including inventories of €1.034 million and cash of €5 thousand) and total liabilities at €4.9 million; equity rose to €4.462 million.

Operating activities generated net cash outflow of €503 thousand (vs €174 thousand outflow in 2024); investing activities used €989 thousand (primarily €1.367 million in production assets and €161 thousand in real estate, partially offset by €539 thousand proceeds from sale of TPD shares); financing activities provided €1.444 million net cash inflow, primarily from a €2.0 million share capital increase completed in October 2025.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows (page 25), Note 13 Equity movements (page 49)
